title: host.result (host → platform, reliable)
description: Exactly one per reliable platform command (ref = its id; auth.rotate is answered by auth.rotated instead). Error codes: bad_args (payload fails validation), unknown_server, match_in_progress (update_safe=false and no force), busy (another job holds the host or the server), expired, stale, unsupported, no_enroll_key, no_release (no Ready Up release / bundle to install), license_not_accepted (install.sh needs a license choice: csm agent config readyup_accept_license), install_failed, not_found (log stream or file), limit (too many followed logs), failed (anything else). output: the job's log (tail, at most 16 KiB, redacted).
